relevance_note: Family case report of HA20 from a TNFAIP3 deletion: '拷贝数变异分析发现先证者及其父亲存在TNFAIP3外显子2~9杂合缺失'.
method_note: Read the whole paper (Chinese case report of one family plus a Discussion with literature examples); built the JSON with a short Python script typing values by hand from my reading. Scope: proband Ⅲ-4 and father Ⅱ-4 (both carry the TNFAIP3 exon 2~9 heterozygous deletion); the mother was tested (WES/CNV of '先证者及其父母') and the deletion was reported only in proband and father, so she gets a row without a variant row; she is labelled 'mother of Ⅲ-4' and recorded female because '父母' names father and mother and the father is Ⅱ-4 (no separate pedigree label in the text; Figure 1 pedigree not available). Previously published people with individual-level facts in the Discussion were added: ref ［6］ patient (same variant, features), ref ［7］ patient (adult onset; one of 19 reported TNFAIP3 CNV patients, no variant printed -> variant row 'not reported'), ref ［9］ girl and her carrier mother, and two brothers from the Japanese survey ref ［20］ (labelled by rule 4 as 'ref ［20］ patient' = younger brother, 'ref ［20］ patient 2' = older brother; no variant printed and the text ties them only to HA20, so no variant rows). '家系中其他成员无发热、腹泻、腹痛、口腔溃疡、关节炎等' refers to untested, unaffected other relatives; not given rows (no individual identification) and not applied to the mother (who was tested). For ref ［6］ and the ref ［9］ mother the variant string is the one the paper prints for the related person, cited with the 'same variant' statement; zygosity/type/pathogenicity left not reported for them per D-29, except variant type for ref ［6］/［7］ taken from the named group of 19 reported TNFAIP3 CNV patients (refs 6-19). Proband age 3岁4个月 is the age at presentation; follow-up continued 1.5 years without a stated age, so last-evaluation age is the presentation age. Pathogenicity '具有致病性' is the authors' ACMG-based inference ('推测'), no ACMG codes printed; qPCR (Figure 3) is validation of the deletion, not a functional assay. Proband: oral mucosa had no ulcer on admission exam despite history of recurrent oral ulcers, and follow-up colonoscopy showed no ulcers after treatment; treated as time-separated findings, not contradictions (checklist kept observed). Perianal ulcers not counted as genital ulcers. 'No rash' and 'superficial lymph nodes not enlarged' are narrower than the composite checklist items, which stay not reported; anemia not stated to be autoimmune, so cytopenia (autoimmune) not reported. Autoantibodies checklist excluded from the negative ANA, autoimmune antibody panel, RF, anti-CCP and ANCA. Father: endoscopy says chronic non-atrophic gastritis while pathology says mild chronic atrophic gastritis (endoscopic vs histological, both recorded as observed). Father's ESR 28, WBC 7.64, CRP 9.67 and fecal calprotectin 176 have no stated interpretation for him, so no feature rows. Father onset 33岁 from the Discussion; the case section says oral ulcers began 3 years earlier at age 36. Ref ［6］ 'fever' not stated as recurrent, so the recurrent-fever checklist item is not reported. Ref ［9］ mother 'no clinical symptoms' recorded as one excluded row; it excludes no specific checklist item. Figures 1-3 and the supplementary table (附表1, 19 CNV patients) are not in the text. first_author not printed in the converted file. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null (not stated).
